items.text: Visited a wellness center at a local high school in CA-19 that provides services for mental health and educational support for our students. These kinds of innovative centers meet young people where they are and help them with the support they need. https://t.co/e0VHKFd4k8

We have important work ahead of us to expand market access for U.S. producers and raise global sustainability, environmental, labor, and nutrition standards. I led a letter urging the Biden Admin to lean in and prioritize policies to feed the world
https://t.co/PBe8qB8UOn

Our bipartisan ROCR Act would create a bundled payment system to incentivize high-value treatment for patients and potentially reduce the frequency of radiation oncology sessions.
https://t.co/gi7YUbmHnp

We need to ensure that Medicare is providing the best care possible for beneficiaries while properly compensating providers in their work. Proud to co-lead legislation to modernize oncology reimbursements and ensure effective treatment for patients.
https://t.co/YYGUE1hlay

We need to ensure Medicare can provide the tailored oncology care that patients need. Our bipartisan legislation would update our payment system to incentivize high-value treatment for patients and potentially reduce the frequency of radiation sessions
https://t.co/EGBl7b4PNr
Good conversation with a constituent about incentivizing and promoting bone marrow and other donation programs which are essential to cancer treatment. https://t.co/14H8qQqAIz

Medicare favors longer courses of cancer treatment and undermines the ability of radiation oncology clinics to provide tailored care. Our bipartisan legislation would ensure this critical program is incentivizing high-value treatment for patients.
https://t.co/oj2ypAZsq1

We need proper oversight over youth residential treatment centers to protect the safety of the children in their care. In the Ways & Means Committee, I discussed bipartisan legislation to coordinate the federal government’s role in safeguarding the wellbeing of foster youth. https://t.co/NqveHWJDPQ

Many Americans have been touched personally by cancer. Early detection can save lives and improve treatment outcomes. Today, we passed bipartisan legislation out of the House Ways and Means Committee to ensure Medicare covers more early screenings. https://t.co/CIjfdbyFGp

One-fourth of suicides in the United States are veterans. We need to do better serving those who served in uniform. I stood alongside a bipartisan group of veterans to demand change on emerging, evidence-backed therapies for PTSD and mental illness.
https://t.co/B8CY5pr2iz

55 million people worldwide are living with Alzheimer's and other dementias. Thanks to local advocates, our community is mobilizing to support research and treatment to fight Alzheimer's and support our neighbors living with this disease. https://t.co/K2M3LHENPn

Promising new treatments like MDMA-assisted therapy have the clinically proven potential to bring Veterans who have long suffered with PTSD a treatment that works. I joined a bipartisan coalition calling on the FDA to take action.
https://t.co/47y3Lve7E0
Met with a constituent about federal and state efforts to ensure the humane treatment of animals. https://t.co/0V19k20T0R
Enjoyed touring the garden at Vineyard Elementary with One Cool Earth.  Their hands-on programs are teaching students about nutrition, sustainability, and the environment. https://t.co/KaTaWm07GV

Proud to receive the Congressional Member of the Year award from American Veterans. Appreciate their partnership in advancing veteran-focused legislation like my VSO Equal Tax Treatment Act, ensuring critical support for organizations serving those who served us. https://t.co/6CNW5sVDZY

Stress, sleep deprivation, and high-intensity training take a toll on servicemembers. We must address this gap in data and ensure they stay healthy & mission-ready. I'm pushing for greater attention to this issue to ensure our servicemembers are cared for.
https://t.co/rky2bmsuEl

I had the privilege of meeting with a veteran today to discuss her service and the importance of supporting trans dependents of military servicemembers. Every family deserves the same support, respect, and care. I’ll continue to fight for my legislation to ensure equal treatment. https://t.co/wlQV7eVnRq

Proud to celebrate the ribbon cutting of the new Wellness Center at Scotts Valley High, a first of its kind in Santa Cruz County made possible with federal investment. This center will provide critical mental health resources for students, ensuring we prioritize youth well-being. https://t.co/DbmN8UrWTj

The opening of the Scotts Valley High Wellness Center is great news! This is a space for students to unwind, find support, and access mental health resources. Proud to have secured federal investment to address the growing mental health needs of our youth.
https://t.co/QruvBx4mMI

Excited to support the Scotts Valley High Wellness Center with federal funding to offer students a space to relax, recharge, and receive critical mental health support. Thanks to this collaborative effort, we’re tackling the youth mental health crisis.
https://t.co/F8SBceTkmr

The federal government actually makes an impact at the local level by investing in projects and programs that make our lives better. This week, we officially opened the Student Wellness Center at Scotts Valley High,
https://t.co/QruvBx4mMI

Despite the chaos in DC, I'm proud that Congress used the power of the purse to help students with the Scotts Valley High Wellness Center. We have to stay focused on the important work needed at every level to improve mental health care in this country.
https://t.co/YcLjebF0Xa

The new Scotts Valley High School Wellness Center is a model for supporting students, and I was proud to help secure federal funding for it. This is an example of the good that federal investment can do in our community, and what I continue to fight for in the 19th Congressional District.
https://t.co/bCDWIBliEF

The Majority passed a budget that is nothing short of reckless, slashing health care, nutrition assistance, and essential services for working families while giving massive tax cuts to billionaires.

I opposed this bill in committee, I opposed it on the floor, and I will continue fighting back. House Republicans are prioritizing tax breaks for billionaires. That’s not fiscal responsibility, that’s a direct attack on working Americans.

I will not stand by while our seniors, children, and families bear the burden of these irresponsible policies that do nothing to build up our communities.
https://t.co/RUfGJxN0V9

It is already against the law for non-citizens to vote in a federal election. I voted no on the SAVE Act because it goes well beyond stopping undocumented individuals from voting, preventing and putting up unnecessary hurdles for eligible Americans to exercise their right to vote.
